title: 5 Tools Everyone in the Pet Grooming Business Should Be Using - Groomer to Groomer

facts.fact: The author states that a customer paying by credit card is statistically proven to spend 20 percent more per average ticket than one paying cash; the article cites no source for this figure.
facts.quote: The customer using a credit card is statistically proven to spend 20 percent more per average ticket than one using cash.

facts.fact: The article presents a list of five tools that every pet grooming business should incorporate into daily operations in 2018.
facts.quote: Here is my top 5 list of “tools” that every Pet Grooming Business should incorporate into their daily operations in 2018.

facts.fact: The author reports that in the author's own shops, more online appointments are scheduled on Sundays than on any other day of the week.
facts.quote: In my shops, more online appointments are scheduled on Sundays than any other day.

facts.fact: The author describes credit card processing sales as largely unregulated, which the author says makes business owners vulnerable to unscrupulous salespersons.
facts.quote: credit card processing sales is akin to the grooming industry as it is largely unregulated as well.

facts.fact: The article defines a Point of Sale System as a software program that tracks daily sales and client records and offers reporting on business statistics.
facts.quote: A Point of Sale System is a software program which will track your daily sales, your client records, and offer a variety of reporting you can use to track your business stats.
